title: Guix reviewed immutable source controllers v3
description: Native bounded data contract for source-owned trusted verifier Git blob identities. This JSON describes reviewed source identities, not Work admission, repository access or runtime deployment.

controllers.description: One record per immutable controller commit; admission separately rejects duplicate commit IDs, including unequal rows.

commit.description: Git SHA-1 commit object ID of the reviewed Guix release controller.

tree.description: Git SHA-1 root tree object ID of the same reviewed commit.

sourceVerifierGitBlobSha1.description: Git SHA-1 blob object ID of scripts/verify-release-source.mjs in the selected controller; native reader hashes its exact bytes before any dynamic import.
